The '''Minyavi sector''' was a remote [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the southwestern [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], near the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
The Minyavi sector was a [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsector]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="EAOC" /> This meant that this remote area was poorly explored or insufficiently documented before the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial period]] and was only recognized as a potential sector by the Empire. Yet, the region was not given a formal sector status when incorporated into [[Imperial Space]] and was not represented in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] for the time being.<ref name="TEA" />

The sector finally obtained a proper sector status from the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] in [[44 ABY]]. It was then represented at the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]] by [[Rokari Kem]].<ref name="Ascension" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', stated that the Minyavi sector and other sectors listed within brackets in the ''Atlas'' appendix were freestanding subsectors.<ref name="Fry">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC_discussion_2023_4.jpg|author=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2023-10-22}}</ref>
